# akeyless_dynamic_secret (Ephemeral Resource)

Fetches a dynamic secret value without storing it in Terraform state. Each plan and apply opens a new credential that expires according to the secret TTL.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `path` (String) The path where the secret is stored.

### Optional

- `args` (List of String) Optional arguments as key=value pairs or JSON strings.
- `dbname` (String) Optional override DB name (MSSQL only).
- `host` (String) Host
- `target` (String) Target Name
- `timeout` (Number) Timeout in seconds

### Read-Only

- `value` (String, Sensitive) The secret contents.
